name: Singapore
headline: Vertical gardens, glass domes, and Sentosa lights.
subheadline: A photo journal across the Lion City.
introduction: Two days wandering through Singapore: the indoor waterfall at Jewel Changi, morning light at Fort Canning, Harry Potter Visions of Magic at Sentosa, and Gardens by the Bay under the night sky.
shortDescription: Two days wandering through Singapore: the indoor waterfall at Jewel Changi, morning light at Fort Canning, Harry Potter Visions of Magic at Sentosa, and Gardens by the Bay under the night sky.
description: Two days wandering through Singapore: the indoor waterfall at Jewel Changi, morning light at Fort Canning, Harry Potter Visions of Magic at Sentosa, and Gardens by the Bay under the night sky.
overview:
Two days wandering through Singapore: the thunderous indoor waterfall at Jewel Changi, quiet morning spirals at Fort Canning, Harry Potter: Visions of Magic and Sentosa by afternoon, and the glowing canopies of Gardens by the Bay under the night sky.

A seamless blend of futuristic greenery and historic colonial corridors, best explored on foot with a camera in hand.
favoriteThings: Jewel Changi waterfall from beneath the lattice dome, Fort Canning tree tunnel in morning mist, and the neon canopy glow of Supertree Grove at Gardens by the Bay.
whatIWouldDoAgain: Take the morning walk from Merlion Park around Marina Bay Sands before the midday heat, and catch the evening Supertree light show.
bestTimeOfDay: Early morning for Fort Canning & Merlion Park
Evening & blue hour for Supertree Grove
localTransport: MRT with contactless card / Apple Pay
weatherNote: Tropical warmth year-round. Brief afternoon showers are common; carry a compact umbrella.
travelTips: Use tap-and-go contactless credit card for the MRT.
Visit Fort Canning tree tunnel early in the morning before crowds arrive.
Jewel Changi Rain Vortex is best viewed on arrival or right before flying home.
Walk from Old Hill Street Police Station across the river to Clarke Quay at dusk.
notFor: Ultra-low budget backpackers seeking cheap street eats only.
Travelers who dislike walking or humid tropical climates.
